CustomField.description: Minor - Near miss or accident or illness without work stoppage (0 to 3 days off) Moderate - Accident or illness with work stoppage (> 4 to 15 days off) Major - Accident or illness with sick leave (16 to 90 days of sick leave) and/or partial permanent incapacity <10% Critical - Accident or sickness with sick leave (91 to > 151 days sick leave) and/or permanent partial incapacity >10% and or fatal illness (0 to 3 days sick leave)
CustomField.inlineHelpText:
Minor - Near miss or accident or illness without work stoppage (0 to 3 days off)
Moderate - Accident or illness with work stoppage (> 4 to 15 days off)
Major - Accident or illness with sick leave (16 to 90 days of sick leave) and/or partial permanent incapacity <10%
Critical - Accident or sickness with sick leave (91 to > 151 days sick leave) and/or permanent partial incapacity >10% and or fatal illness (0 to 3 days sick leave)
CustomField.label: Severity
